positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on site for TEKSystem's client SystemLink, Inc. doing windows desktop application development using design patterns (factory and repository), C#, WPF, Agile (Kanban), TFS, SQL Server.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Developer and onsite support for Axiell Registries + Vital Records at the Washington DC Department of Health Vital Records Division.

Website/Application Development using C#, .Net, Entity Framework, jQuery, MVC framework, SQL, SQL Server, Agile software development, AWS, Data Warehousing.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
Converted Carroll Publishing’s e-commerce site from Visual Basic/VB script to C#/.Net

Application development using C# .Net.

Worked on development of a customer data provisioning web service using Soap/XML in VB .NET.

Designed and developed a system for downloading, processing, and uploading large amounts of XML data into Carroll Publishing’s database to assist with the launch of a new product.

Developing new applications and systems to deal with problems as they arise such as getting new data, manipulating current data, automating new tasks. 

Responsible for maintenance, error fixing, and new development of the Carroll Publishing Editorial System which is a browser/SQL based system for real time creation/maintenance of Carroll’s government information data as well as the source for Carroll’s product delivery.

Developed programs in Visual Basic 6.0 to automate several time-intensive tasks that required several hours or more of work and monitoring. The programs I developed allowed the person responsible for the task to set up the parameters for the program run and then the program ran automatically over night.

Created Web Crawler Spiders using a variety of Perl, C#, Visual Basic 6.0 programs to access various websites and collect and process new data to be added to the Carroll Publishing database. 

Provided a GUI interface to the Carroll Publishing’s CD database product using Visual Basic

Created the capability to access, reformat and load external data sources into the company’s database product. Wrote several programs to modify and load data from external files with various formats into Carroll Publishing’s main database.

positions.title: Intern Programmer
positions.description:
Developed several Unix Shell scripts in Perl to aide the System Administrator in checking up on the validity of employee passwords and preventing unauthorized computer usage

Worked on the initial development of the ATCC’s intranet site and an external website the ATCC was providing support for

Assisted in the system upgrade of the ATCC database from Progress version 8.5g to Progress version 9.0; ensured that all functionality was retained. Wrote new and modified existing Progress 4GL programs to complete the project.
